title: Gross margin
definition: Revenue less the standardized finance cost amount for the same company, period, and currency.
interpretation: A positive change means the absolute gross margin increased; it does not by itself establish the cause.

title: Revenue amount
definition: The semantic finance revenue amount calculated from quantity multiplied by unit price.
interpretation: Revenue movement is an observed driver signal and is not a causal conclusion on its own.

title: Cost amount
definition: The standardized finance cost amount associated with the same company, period, and currency.
interpretation: Cost movement is an observed driver signal and requires supporting operational evidence for causal analysis.
